## Ecosystem description and assessment

Ecosystem accounts provided in this section consist of two components, an
ecosystem description and a detailed summary of the application of the IUCN Red
List of Ecosystem criteria.
The ecosystem description follows the standard format suggested by the IUCN.
Ecosystem descriptions are an essential component of IUCN Red List of Ecosystems
assessments and serve the purpose of clearly defining each assessment unit.
This allows repeated application of the categories and criteria to a single
defined unit and supports red listing and cross-walking at the
global scale.
The associated assessment section provides the details the Red List assessments,
including the data sources, methods of analysis, evidence statements and key
references.

: Components of ecosystem description {#tbl-components}

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| Authors | Authors of the description and the assessment. |
| Myanmar ecosystem names | Alternative names of the ecosystem. |
| Biome | Biome membership according to the global ecosystem typology. |
| Functional group | Functional group membership according to the global ecosystem typology. |
| Global classification | Classification code according to the global ecosystem typology. |
| Description | General overview of the principal components and dynamics of the ecosystem. Includes a photograph of the ecosystem. |
| Distribution | Short written description and range map of the spatial distribution of the ecosystem. |
| Characteristic native biota | Identifies the defining biotic features of the ecosystem, including diagnostic native taxa, functional components of the characteristic biota. |
| Abiotic environment | Identifies the defining abiotic features of the ecosystem, including descriptions of the characteristic states or summary of values of the key abiotic variables. |
| Key processes and interactions | Describes the key ecosystem drivers and interactions among biota and the abiotic environment. |
| Major threats | Short summary of the major threats and impacts to the ecosystem. |
| Ecosystem collapse definition | Short description of the collapsed state of the ecosystem and any associated thresholds. |
| Assessment summary | Short summary of the red list of ecosystems assessment. |
| Assessment outcome | Short format assessed status of the ecosystem. |
| IUCN Red List of Ecosystems Categories and Criteria | Version of the IUCN Red List of Ecosystems criteria used in the assessment. |
| Year published | Publication year. |
| Date assessed | The date the ecosystem assessment was completed. |
| Assessment credits | Names the authors, reviewers and contributors to the assessment. |
| Assessment summary | Short summary of the red list of ecosystems assessment. |
| Criterion A | Description of data, analysis and methods used to assess the criterion and the status outcome. |
| Criterion B | Description of data, analysis and methods used to assess the criterion and the status outcome. |
| Criterion C | Description of data, analysis and methods used to assess the criterion and the status outcome. |
| Criterion D | Description of data, analysis and methods used to assess the criterion and the status outcome. |
| Criterion E | Description of data, analysis and methods used to assess the criterion and the status outcome. |

## Summary of assessment outcomes

```{python}
#| label: summary-criteria-table
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml
from rle.core import rle_category

project_root = Path(os.environ.get('PIXI_PROJECT_ROOT', str(Path('..').resolve())))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root / 'scripts'))
from _criteria import CRITERIA, criteria_summary


def _status_cell(value):
    # Same color coding as the per-ecosystem criteria table; values that are not
    # a category code (e.g. a free-text outcome) render plain.
    cat = rle_category(value)
    if not cat:
        return f'<td>{value}</td>'
    bg = cat['background_color']
    fg = '#000' if bg in ('yellow', 'green', 'lightgray', 'white') else '#fff'
    return (f'<td style="background:{bg};color:{fg};font-weight:bold;'
            f'text-align:center;">{value}</td>')


ecos = []
for eco_file in (project_root / 'config' / 'ecosystems').glob('*/ecosystem.yaml'):
    with open(eco_file) as f:
        ecos.append(yaml.safe_load(f))
# Index order, matching the sidebar; ecosystems without an index sort last.
ecos.sort(key=lambda e: (e.get('index') is None, e.get('index') or 0,
                         str(e['global_classification'])))

rows = []
for eco in ecos:
    code = eco['global_classification']
    name = eco.get('ecosystem_name') or code
    label = name if str(name) == str(code) else f'{name} ({code})'
    href = f'3_ecosystem_assessments/{code}/{code}.html'
    summary = criteria_summary(eco)
    cells = ''.join(_status_cell(summary[c]) for c in CRITERIA + ['overall'])
    rows.append(f'<tr><td>{eco.get("index", "")}</td>'
                f'<td><a href="{href}">{label}</a></td>{cells}</tr>')

header = ''.join(f'<th>{c}</th>' for c in CRITERIA)
print(
    '<table class="criteria-table">\n'
    f'<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Ecosystem</th>{header}<th>Overall</th></tr></thead>\n'
    '<tbody>\n' + '\n'.join(rows) + '\n</tbody>\n</table>'
)
print(
    '\n::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}\n'
    'Each criterion shows the most threatened category among its sub-criteria. '
    '**Overall** is the assessment outcome when one has been recorded, otherwise '
    'the most threatened of criteria A–E. Criterion B1 and B2 reflect the EOO and '
    'AOO spatial thresholds only.\n'
    ':::'
)
```

:::: {.callout-important}
## How to customize the Ecosystem description page

- To modify the introductory text or the components table, edit the
`content/3_ecosystem_description.qmd` file.
- The summary of assessment outcomes table is built from
`config/ecosystems/*/ecosystem.yaml`. Edit the `criteria_status` and
`assessment_outcome` fields there to update it.
- To fill in the computed Criterion B1/B2 categories, run
`pixi run build-criterion-b` and commit the updated configs.

**To hide these instructions on all pages, set `show-instructions: false`
in the `_quarto.yml` file.**
::::
:::
